verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm programmatic creation of deposit accounts (including FBO structures) via API, which is the core capability, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a sandbox/test environment for parity testing, no explicit FDIC-insurance language, and probes show API reference/OpenAPI endpoints returning 404s, undermining confidence in full self-serve API documentation. missing for 10: sandbox environment documentation, explicit insured-deposit (FDIC) claims, working API reference/OpenAPI spec.
